traffic_eavesdropping.description: An attacker observes network traffic to obtain sensitive information.

malicious_intermediary.description: An attacker positions itself between communicating parties.

denial_of_service.description: An attacker consumes resources so legitimate users cannot access the service.

insufficient_authorization.description: An authenticated user accesses resources beyond the permissions granted to that identity.

virtualization_attack.description: An attack targets virtualization boundaries or virtual machine infrastructure.

overlapping_trust_boundaries.description: A weakness exists because multiple trust boundaries overlap incorrectly.

containerization_attack.description: An attacker abuses a weakness in container isolation or configuration.

malware.description: Malicious software executes inside or against the environment.

insider_threat.description: A trusted person abuses legitimate access.

social_engineering.description: An attacker manipulates people into revealing information or performing unsafe actions.

botnet.description: A coordinated set of compromised systems is used to perform attacks.

privilege_escalation.description: An attacker obtains privileges beyond those initially granted.

brute_force.description: An attacker repeatedly attempts credentials or authentication values.

remote_code_execution.description: An attacker causes arbitrary code to execute remotely.

sql_injection.description: Untrusted input changes the intended meaning of a database query.

tunneling.description: A communication channel is hidden or encapsulated inside another protocol.

advanced_persistent_threat.description: A capable attacker maintains a long-term presence in an environment.
